changes: MUTE HLD (and the mode it returns to), MUTE TGL, FILL HLD and FILL LAT are played through the base's key chain (core_key), so other mods that follow pages and held keys see them as a panel press. PLAY (REC HLD, REC TGL) still goes to stock alone, so QPER Live Rec does not read it as QPER + PLAY.
stockPolicy: No firmware or stock-derived code/tables are present. Addresses, lengths and SHA-256 guards are metadata; exported instructions and sections are authored module code. Local materialized recipes and firmware are never committed.
